case_name: Sher Singh (Dead) By Lrs v Joint Director of Consolidation and Others
holding: Sher Singh acquired the rights of a Bhumidhar as stated. He became entitled to retain possession of the fields as a Sirdar under s. 19 of the Act and on depositing an amount equal to ten times the land revenue payable or deemed to be payable, he became entitled to a declaration that he had acquired the rights of a Bhumidhar mentioned in s. 137 of the Act in respect of the said fields and to the grant of a certificate to that effect.
